title: Factory Accident Crisis Chain
description: Cascading impact analysis of a rare industrial catastrophe with branching consequences across health, transport, and environment.

events.name: Factory Accident
events.detail: Structural failure or operational error at industrial facility

events.name: Fire Outbreak
events.detail: Ignition of flammable materials triggers uncontrolled fire

events.name: Road Block
events.detail: Emergency vehicles and fire brigade close surrounding roads

events.name: Chemical Leak
events.detail: Hazardous substance release — chlorine / toxic gas detected

events.name: Mass Casualty
events.detail: Multiple workers and civilians exposed to toxic substances

events.name: Hospital Overload
events.detail: District hospital exceeds ICU capacity — mutual aid required

events.name: Air Pollution
events.detail: Toxic plume spreads across 2km radius based on wind direction
